hero.name: Gregor Krykon
hero.title: Junior Software Developer · DevOps · AI Engineering
hero.tagline: I automate development, rollout and infrastructure, and build my projects with AI in my own harness.

about.heading: About Me
about.body1: I'm Gregor, 21. I have been developing software out of passion for 6 years.
about.body2: From games and web shops I ended up in automation and development. At FELLOWPRO AG I work on CI/CD, test automation and DevOps; privately I run my own projects on self-hosted infrastructure. I finish my apprenticeship in February 2027.
about.body3: I build my own projects mainly with AI: I design the spec, the plan, the acceptance criteria and AI agents, and then carry out the development with Claude Code in my own self-built harness. At FELLOWPRO I developed a set of Claude skills for everyday developer work and introduced them in the team, including a guided introduction to Claude Code. I'm motivated to get the most out of the time invested, with AI-assisted development or with conventional processes.
about.body4: My approach: build, test, ship, optimise, repeat.

agent_harness.title: My own agent harness (orchestrator) for Claude Code
agent_harness.desc: I build many of my projects with Claude Code: I write the plans, sub-agents implement them. A loop contract with a stop hook keeps the agent working until the checks pass, and an independent LLM judge reviews the result. For me a step only counts as done once tests and review have passed. I keep developing this harness on my own, piece by piece, to bring in new innovations and use the best methods.

nodewar.title: Nodewar – browser idle game
nodewar.desc: A browser idle game: you build nodes around a core on a hex grid and defend it against waves. I set it up as a “code factory”: I maintain the roadmap, my harness generates a loop contract per release from it, and several agents build the features in parallel until CI and the checks pass. After every release a retro agent looks at what the factory itself could do better.

homelab.title: My homelab
homelab.desc: My projects run on three servers that I set up myself. Along the way I learned a lot about Docker, Traefik and monitoring, often from my own mistakes.

workflows.title: Reusable CI/CD workflows
workflows.desc: Instead of maintaining a separate pipeline in every project, all my repos use shared workflows, to keep maintenance low and make new projects easier to set up. The repo is public on GitHub.

home_ecosystem.title: My dashboard
home_ecosystem.desc: I used to keep finances, sleep data and server status in different tools, now I see everything in an app of my own. Building it taught me how an API, a background service and a frontend work together.

kicker.title: Kicker
kicker.desc: We use the app to record our foosball games on our phones, and the leaderboard comes from Elo ratings. The first version was online after two days, after that I extended it step by step.

samhain_app.title: Samhain murder-mystery dinner app
samhain_app.desc: For Samhain Verlag's murder-mystery dinner boxes I built a Flutter companion app, available on Google Play. The content comes from my CDN on Cloudflare; each game is downloaded once and then works offline too. The solution stays locked until you unlock it with the box's EAN.

samhain_platform.title: Samhain content platform
samhain_platform.desc: Every small text correction in the Samhain app used to need a new release. So I moved the content into a content management system that the app and the website fetch their data from on their own.

samhain.title: samhain-verlag.de
samhain.desc: I replaced the publisher's old WordPress site with a static Astro site that uses the same content as the app. Before every deployment a script backs up the current state and rolls back automatically if something fails.

sweatvalley_bingo.title: Sweatvalley Bingo
sweatvalley_bingo.desc: A bingo for the classroom where everyone joins with a code and ticks off their card live. I built it with React and Socket.io and put it online on my server.

krimispiele.title: krimispiele.com
krimispiele.desc: This is where Samhain Verlag sells its murder-mystery dinner games. I set up the Shopware shop and have looked after it ever since.

krimidinnerverzeichnis.title: krimidinnerverzeichnis.de
krimidinnerverzeichnis.desc: Anyone looking for a murder-mystery dinner finds providers from the German-speaking region on one page here. I built the site for an organiser of crime events.

praxis_it.title: Part-time job: IT for a medical practice
praxis_it.desc: In a part-time job I do IT support for a medical practice and build up its internal systems. This included moving the old physical Windows server onto a new Proxmox host as a virtual machine. I documented the systems and worked out a backup concept for the patient data.

soenke.quote: What I especially appreciate about working with Gregor: he turns ideas into reality right away instead of debating them endlessly. Very quickly you get a working tool or site that is then refined and optimised together.
soenke.name: Sönke Busch
